trans-unit.source: Change the tag of this header
The tag comes from the original of the default language and is changed there.
The heading could not be changed. The text may have been changed in the meantime; the structure is loaded again.
Show or hide the heading structure
The page is not translated into this language.
The page is hidden. The structure shows how it will look when the page is published.
The page is not published yet (from %s). The structure shows how it will look from then on.
The page is no longer published (until %s). The structure shows how it looked shortly before it ended.
The page can never be shown: its end time is not after its start time.
The page is only visible to frontend users of the groups %s. The structure shows how it looks for them.
The page is only visible to logged-in frontend users. The structure shows how it looks for them.
The page can never be shown: the frontend user groups of the page and of its parents exclude each other.
You work in the workspace "%s". The structure shows the versions of this workspace.
The frontend of this page could not be loaded, so the headings cannot be shown.
The heading structure could not be loaded.
